pre_data_options.idea: A rain-soaked arrival at a dark planetarium workbench: a technician keeps her hair clear while reseating the perforated star disc into a lamp housing, with the lower tips carrying recent rain and the protected crown still dry.

A conservator at a greenhouse observatory saving a paper astrolabe after a leaking skylight: she holds an outer hair panel away from the fragile paper, exposing its pale underlayer, while rain remains only at the ends.
A projectionist in a ferry cabin rescues a warped transparency under a work lamp after crossing the wet deck; one hand sweeps the outer hair panel away and the other steadies a lens tray.
